end.parentNote: Manav practised grouping animals by what they eat and building food chains using arrows. They explained that the eater comes next and correctly read chains such as algae → larvae → fish. No specific mix-up was recorded. At home, ask them to make one chain with a plant, an animal that eats plants, and an animal that eats that animal.
